review.notes: Gate at c00e220 fails on residue (6 anchor tags) and depcheck (UPWARD and CYCLE with NoncompactQuantumSymmetry); all other gate checks 0; lake env lean elaborates Suggested.lean with sorry as the only warnings; #check of the 4 declarations matches the README; one-tactic probes (simp, infer_instance, rfl) close nothing. Two further roadmap-level cycles found by hand (SmoothBanachRepresentations #1145 and QuaternionicModularForms #934 both cite this roadmap back and are outside the merge order, so the tool loads no edges for them). Section 2.2 cites LieHighestWeight Layer 9 declarations (productEnveloping, splitEnveloping, tensorCenterInclusion*, the reductive centre and Harish-Chandra isomorphisms) that exist only in revision PR #1220, not on main. Borel-Jacquet, Flath and Langlands (Corvallis) not legally readable; Harris and Clozel (Milne scans) OCR unfinished at close. 36-row adversarial table with computed values; 9 Mathlib and 30 Tau Ceti declarations opened at the pins; cross-roadmap sections resolved on main and at open heads.
